cohort_total_n_excerpt: A total of 753 newly diagnosed prostate cancer cases, 40-64 years of age, participated in the study. Seven hundred three control subjects, frequency matched to cases by age, were selected through random digit dialing.
reason: The abstract analyzes newly diagnosed prostate cancer overall and does not report an aggressive incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Each additional glass of red wine consumed per week showed a statistically significant 6% decrease in relative risk (OR = 0.94; 95% CI = 0.90-0.98), and there was evidence for a decline in risk estimates across increasing categories of red wine intake (trend p = 0.02).
estimate_classifications.reason: The red-wine estimate concerns overall prostate cancer risk, not aggressive disease.
